head: codex/55-coverage-aggregate-big-runner
title: [defect][ci][coverage] Route hosted coverage aggregation to the 16-core runner
body:
Closes #55

Routes only the heavyweight `adl-coverage-hosted` aggregation job through the established `ADL_HEAVY_RUNNER` selector with the 16-core fallback. Adds focused fail-closed regression assertions while preserving the lightweight stable aggregator, producers, Spot opt-in, artifacts, Codecov, thresholds, and coverage policy.

Focused proof: workflow YAML parse; CI runtime contracts; CI path-policy contracts; typed larger-runner preflight 1/1; exact-head independent review with no findings.
